name: @taucad/render
description: Headless GLB renderer for one or many ordered image views, with optional deterministic capture annotations.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build rust/render-wasm --release --target web --out-dir ../../src/wasm && rm -f src/wasm/.gitignore
scripts.build:napi: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release -p render-napi && mkdir -p src/native && cp rust/target/release/librender_napi.dylib src/native/render-napi.node
scripts.spike:native: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release -p render-core --example render -- spike/fixtures/interleaved-instanced-lines.glb spike/out/native-interleaved.png
scripts.bench:native: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release -p render-core --example bench -- spike/fixtures/gear-12.glb
scripts.spike:napi: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release -p render-napi && cp rust/target/release/librender_napi.dylib spike/render-napi.node
